title: चरीको विलाप
description: A celebrated passage from Lekhnath Paudyal's तरुण तपसी, widely anthologized on its own as 'चरीको विलाप' (The Bird's Lament): a bird struck by a hunter cries out — pleading the cruelty done to its mate and orphaned chicks — and exalts दया (compassion) as the true soul of humanity.

rights.basis: Author died 1966; public domain since 2016 (Nepal's Copyright Act 2059: life + 50 years).

summary: साथी वा जोडीबाट छुटेको चराले वनभरि खोज्दै गरेको करुण विलाप।
